test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

He and his father __take a ride__ every morning to the top of the hill.
solution:
The correct answer is 'No substitution required.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **No error** **lies** in the given underlined sentence.
 
• The sentence is written in **Simple Present Tense**.
 
• Simple Present Tense Structure: Subject + V1 + s/es(if singular subject) + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Here subject "**He and his father**" is **plural**, hence we **will not use s/es** in V1.
 __
 
• *Example: Raj **eats** bread and butter before going to school*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the use of 'take a ride' in the sentence is absolutely correct.
 
• Hence, No substitution required.

 

*Correct sentence__: He and his father __take a ride__ every morning to the top of the hill.*
